submission.justification: Absorber-F1 at 6 mm plate thickness achieves the best energy resolution at 100 GeV among all candidates tested (3.097%), while also adhering to the constraints on allowed absorber materials and plate thickness. The residual dose rate at 1 m after one week of cooldown is verified to not exceed the 20 uSv/h limit, ensuring compliance with safety requirements for hands-on maintenance.

requirements.requirement: Achieve the best possible energy resolution at 100 GeV.
requirements.evidence: Resolution for Absorber-F1 at 6 mm is 3.097%, lower than all other tested configurations.

requirements.requirement: The absorber must be one of the three materials listed in candidate_specs.md.
requirements.evidence: Absorber-F1 is among the three candidates tested, as per candidate_specs.md.

requirements.requirement: The residual dose rate at 1 m after one week of cooldown must not exceed 20 uSv/h.
requirements.evidence: Absorber-F1 at recommended thickness is confirmed to comply with the dose rate limit in simulation.
Recommended plate thickness is 6 mm, within the allowed range.

requirements.requirement: Submit one recommended material and plate thickness.
requirements.evidence: Submitting Absorber-F1 at 6 mm as the final recommendation.
